# Normalization profile field index

<!-- Generated by engine/scripts/generate_profile_schema.py. -->

See the [authoring guide](../../workflows/normalization/author-profile.md) for working trade and depth examples. Angle brackets mark a key you supply. Empty brackets mark an array item. An optional key is unset when omitted unless a default is listed. A field marked conditional depends on its enclosing table, target or transform. Applicability labels distinguish trade and depth fields. The compiler and reader check the whole combination.

## Identity

Schema discriminator, installed identity and inventory-only marker. Match the venue, instrument and market to the catalogue.

Use the filename `<id>.toml` under the matching `trades/` or `depth/` directory. Valid market pairs are spot/spot, perpetual or future with linear or inverse, option/option, and equity/equity. A valid identity does not establish reader support.

| Field | Type and presence | Meaning and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="exchange"></a>`exchange` | identifier · required · trades, depth | Execution venue code, including manual venues. One to 32 lowercase ASCII letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. The reserved code external is rejected. |
| <a id="format_code"></a>`format_code` | identifier · required · trades, depth | Venue and content format identity used by catalogue resolution. Venue uppercase with hyphens in place of underscores. Gate.io uses GATE. Suffix T or B plus a positive decimal integer without leading zero. Must be unambiguous in its venue and market namespace. |
| <a id="id"></a>`id` | identifier · required · trades, depth | Exact installed namespace and filename stem. exchange.instrument_type.market_category.trades\|depth Must agree with the three identity keys and installed trades/ or depth/ directory. |
| <a id="instrument_type"></a>`instrument_type` | enum · required · trades, depth | Instrument kind matched by the catalogue and task. `"spot"` — Spot instrument. `"perpetual"` — Perpetual contract. `"future"` — Dated future. `"option"` — Option contract. `"equity"` — Cash equity. |
| <a id="kind"></a>`kind` | literal · required · trades, depth | Document kind. `"profile"` — Standalone normalization profile. |
| <a id="market_category"></a>`market_category` | enum · required · trades, depth | Market namespace used for matching. `"spot"` — Spot instruments. `"linear"` — Linear perpetuals or futures. `"inverse"` — Inverse perpetuals or futures. `"option"` — Options. `"equity"` — Cash equities. |
| <a id="schema_version"></a>`schema_version` | literal · required · trades, depth | Authoring schema discriminator. `2` — Current self-contained TOML profile. |
| <a id="unsupported_reason"></a>`unsupported_reason` | string · optional · trades, depth | Mark this definition inventory-only with a nonblank reason. Rust checks structure and references but does not enable its processing rules. |

## Source

Archive wrapper, record representation and source layout.

Read the format and layout rows together. Trades take CSV or JSONL with `rows`. Depth supports JSONL events and snapshots, specific positional CSV layouts, and a fixed XLSX snapshot layout. Archive members, headers and the selected mappings must match an implemented reader. For XLSX use one header sheet with exactly `timestamp`, `asks` and `bids`, Unix seconds, and common `input_ordering = { order = "ascending", sort_by = "timestamp" }`.

| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="source_1"></a>`source` | table · required · trades, depth | Physical input metadata. |

| <a id="sourcecontainer"></a>`source.container` | enum · required · trades, depth | Outer wrapper, independent of the inner record representation. `"plain"` — Uncompressed input. `"gzip"` — Gzip stream. `"zip"` — ZIP archive member. `"tar_gzip"` — Gzip-compressed tar member. |
| <a id="sourcedaily_packaging"></a>`source.daily_packaging` | literal · optional · trades, depth | Descriptive daily package shape. `"numbered_zip_chunks"` — Numbered ZIP chunks. |
| <a id="sourceformat"></a>`source.format` | enum · required · trades | Physical format decoded after opening the wrapper. `"csv"` — Comma-separated records. `"jsonl"` — One JSON value per line. |
| `source.format` | enum · required · depth | Physical format decoded after opening the wrapper. `"csv"` — Comma-separated records. `"jsonl"` — One JSON value per line. `"xlsx"` — Excel workbook with the fixed depth layout. |
| <a id="sourcegranularity"></a>`source.granularity` | enum · required · trades, depth | Descriptive archive packaging interval, independent of event frequency. `"daily"` — Daily package. `"hourly"` — Hourly package. `"monthly"` — Monthly package. |

| <a id="sourceordering"></a>`source.ordering` | enum · required · trades, depth | Declared source ordering. `"chronological"` — Source-ordered input. `"timestamp_sortable"` — Input that can be sorted by timestamp. `"not_chronological"` — Alias for timestamp_sortable. |
| <a id="sourcerecord_format"></a>`source.record_format` | enum · required · trades | Logical grouping of records, independent of the physical format. `"rows"` — Trade rows. |

| <a id="sourcetrade_id_reset_domain"></a>`source.trade_id_reset_domain` | string · conditional · trades | Nonblank native identifier reset domain. Required for instrument_scoped and ordered_run. Forbidden for other scopes or when scope is omitted. |

Trade-only. Requires a native normalization.trade_id.field mapping. |
| <a id="sourceworkbook_sheets"></a>`source.workbook_sheets` | literal · conditional · trades, depth · xlsx | Number of worksheets supported by the fixed workbook layout. `1` — Exactly one worksheet. Required for XLSX and forbidden otherwise. XLSX requires header=true, timestamp-sortable input, exactly timestamp/asks/bids, Unix seconds, and ascending timestamp sort. |

## Fields

Replace <name> with a real source column or JSON path. Use [fields."data.ts"] for a dotted raw key. Omit optional TOML keys to leave them unset unless a default is documented.

In executable mappings, `field = "size"` references the declared `[fields.size]` key. For nested JSON use a literal dotted key such as `[fields."data.ts"]` and `field = "data.ts"`. Where listed, `source` is a compatibility spelling. Prefer `field`, and use only `field` for the event timestamp and trade instrument bindings. CSV positions start at one. Level-array indices start at zero. Precision annotations describe the source and `encoding` selects the decoder.

| Field | Type and presence | Meaning and constraints |

| <a id="fieldsname"></a>`fields.<name>` | table · conditional · trades, depth | One literal source column or JSON path. Quote a dotted key in TOML. At least one field is required. |
| <a id="fieldsnamedecode"></a>`fields.<name>.decode` | literal · optional · trades, depth | Encoding of a structured source field. `"json"` — JSON-encoded cell or value. |
| <a id="fieldsnameencoding"></a>`fields.<name>.encoding` | enum · conditional · trades, depth | Timestamp encoding for a mapped source field. `"unix_seconds"` — Unix epoch seconds. `"unix_milliseconds"` — Unix epoch milliseconds. `"unix_microseconds"` — Unix epoch microseconds. `"unix_nanoseconds"` — Unix epoch nanoseconds. `"iso8601_nanoseconds"` — ISO 8601 text with nanosecond precision. Required for each effective event_timestamp field. If either timestamp uses ISO 8601, both mapped timestamps must declare ISO 8601 and type string. |
| <a id="fieldsnamefractional_digits"></a>`fields.<name>.fractional_digits` | TOML value · optional · trades, depth | Descriptive fractional-digit evidence. The compiler does not enforce a digit cap from this key. |

## Normalization

Map raw fields to canonical operations. Use [[normalization.rules]] for multiple targets. Each item inherits common mappings and cannot override a common key.

Use one `target` or a nonempty `[[normalization.rules]]` array. Each item has its own target and inherits common mappings without overriding their keys. The tables below show the common paths. Use the same mapping keys within rules where applicable. Keep `quantity_encoding`, `book` and the trade instrument binding in common normalization. With depth, use an unsequenced path when both sequence mappings are absent, a consecutive policy with only `sequence_start`, or a ranged policy with both. All rules in a task must agree. See the bounded-observation exception below.

Compare a normalized sample to the raw price and size. `"base"` — The vendor measures size in units of the underlying asset. `"quote"` — The vendor measures size in the quote currency. `"contracts"` — The vendor reports a count of contracts. Requires a compatible derivative instrument. Spot and equity reject it. Required when the containing table is used. |

At normalization level, choose target or a nonempty rules array. Each rule item requires its own target. Targets must be unique and agree with profile content. |

| <a id="normalizationupdate_semanticszero_result"></a>`normalization.update_semantics.zero_result` | literal · optional · depth | Interpret a zero resulting size. `"delete"` — Remove the level. |

| Field | Type and presence | Meaning and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="normalizationasks"></a>`normalization.asks` | table · conditional · depth | Ask-array mapping. Requires bids. Mutually exclusive with scalar price, quantity and side. |

| <a id="normalizationaskslevel_fields"></a>`normalization.asks.level_fields` | table · optional · depth | Mapping-local alternative to positional or raw-field object layout. Requires field. Cannot override level_format or level_fields in the raw declaration. |
| <a id="normalizationaskslevel_fieldsorder_count"></a>`normalization.asks.level_fields.order_count` | string · optional · depth | Optional nonempty order count member in the same object level. |
| <a id="normalizationaskslevel_fieldsprice"></a>`normalization.asks.level_fields.price` | string · conditional · depth | Nonempty price member name in an object level. Required when the containing table is used. |
| <a id="normalizationaskslevel_fieldsquantity"></a>`normalization.asks.level_fields.quantity` | string · conditional · depth | Nonempty quantity member name in an object level. Required when the containing table is used. |

| <a id="normalizationasksquantity_field"></a>`normalization.asks.quantity_field` | string · conditional · depth | Explicit object size member. Supply price_field and quantity_field together. |

Zero when omitted and not derived from level_format. Set the indices explicitly or declare level_format so they differ. Default `0`. |
| <a id="normalizationaskssource"></a>`normalization.asks.source` | source field reference · optional · depth | Direct source-field spelling accepted by the compiled rule parser. Prefer field in authored profiles. |
| <a id="normalizationbids"></a>`normalization.bids` | table · conditional · depth | Bid-array mapping. Requires asks. Mutually exclusive with scalar price, quantity and side. |

| <a id="normalizationbidslevel_fieldsprice"></a>`normalization.bids.level_fields.price` | string · conditional · depth | Nonempty price member name in an object level. Required when the containing table is used. |
| <a id="normalizationbidslevel_fieldsquantity"></a>`normalization.bids.level_fields.quantity` | string · conditional · depth | Nonempty quantity member name in an object level. Required when the containing table is used. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsorder_count_field"></a>`normalization.bids.order_count_field` | string · optional · depth | Optional nonempty order count member for object levels. Requires object price and quantity members. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsorder_count_index"></a>`normalization.bids.order_count_index` | integer · optional · depth | Optional unsigned zero-based order count position for positional levels. Not compatible with object price and quantity members. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsprice_field"></a>`normalization.bids.price_field` | string · conditional · depth | Explicit object price member. Supply price_field and quantity_field together or use level_fields to declare them. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsprice_index"></a>`normalization.bids.price_index` | integer · optional · depth | Explicit zero-based price position in a positional level. Zero when omitted and not derived from level_format. Positional levels require distinct indices. Default `0`. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsquantity_field"></a>`normalization.bids.quantity_field` | string · conditional · depth | Explicit object size member. Supply price_field and quantity_field together. |
| <a id="normalizationbidsquantity_index"></a>`normalization.bids.quantity_index` | integer · optional · depth | Explicit zero-based size position in a positional level. Zero when omitted and not derived from level_format. Set the indices explicitly or declare level_format so they differ. Default `0`. |
| <a id="normalizationbidssource"></a>`normalization.bids.source` | source field reference · optional · depth | Direct source-field spelling accepted by the compiled rule parser. Prefer field in authored profiles. |

For tuple levels such as `[[99, 2]]`, use `level_format = ["price", "quantity"]` on the raw array field. For object levels such as `[{"p":99,"q":2}]`, use `level_fields = { price = "p", quantity = "q" }` instead. Apply the mapping to each side's declared raw key.

## Feeds

Gate.io depth can declare snapshot and incremental feed variants. Replace <feed> with one of those keys. Each feed supplies its own source, fields and normalization.

Each variant has its own complete depth [Source](#source), [Fields](#fields) and [Normalization](#normalization) tables. Keep the complete top-level definition as well. Set `feed = "snapshot"` or `feed = "incremental"` in acquisition request source options.

| Field | Type and presence | Meaning and constraints |
| --- | --- | --- |
| <a id="feeds_1"></a>`feeds` | table · optional · depth | Optional Gate.io depth feed map. Default `{}`. |
| <a id="feedsfeed"></a>`feeds.<feed>` | table · optional · depth | Complete feed override with its own source, fields and normalization. Only snapshot and incremental feed keys are supported. Only Gate.io depth. |
| <a id="feedsfeedfields"></a>`feeds.<feed>.fields` | table · conditional · depth | Complete raw field definitions for this variant. Required when the containing table is used. |
| <a id="feedsfeednormalization"></a>`feeds.<feed>.normalization` | table · conditional · depth | Complete depth operations for this variant. Required when the containing table is used. |
| <a id="feedsfeedsource"></a>`feeds.<feed>.source` | table · conditional · depth | Complete physical metadata for this variant. Required when the containing table is used. |
